reviewNote: Compiled from the official sources named on each row on 2026-10-14. Not yet reviewed by a chartered accountant. A source marked "confirmed": false could not be opened and checked; it is the most specific official page found. Extended dates announced later by notification or circular are not included.
sourceMeans: Each source has its notification or circular date (null when the page states none) and whether it was opened and found to state the date ("confirmed").

rules.monthly: Due every month on `day` (or the last day of the month when `day` is "last"). `months` limits the calendar months it falls in; `overrides` replaces the day in a named month.
rules.annual: Due every year on each MM-DD in `dates` (quarterly returns list their four dates).

allMeans: A state list of ["all"] applies in every state and union territory.
